data.title: 古手川唯 · 泳池点名的严肃整队
data.description: 彩南高中的游泳课热身前，古手川唯赤脚站在湛蓝泳池边的阳光下，一手夹着防水点名板、一手扶起吹散的长发，一丝不苟地叮嘱大家下水前做好热身、严禁在池边追逐。尽管穿着深蓝死库水，她浑身上下依旧透着铁面风纪委员的认真劲儿。
data.location: 蓝天白云映衬的彩南高中露天泳池边
data.action: 赤脚站于池边手持点名板认真整队叮嘱，另一手轻抚额发
data.lighting: 清朗夏日日光与水面明快波光
data.camera: 平视中全身，展现笔直站姿与清澈蓝天泳池
data.promptProse: Standing straight and barefoot beside the sparkling blue lanes of the Sainan High School pool, Yui holds a waterproof attendance clipboard to her side while tucking windblown black hair behind her ear. Even in a navy school swimsuit, her expression stays strictly focused as she calls the class to order.
data.animaCaption: Barefoot by the sunny school pool, she holds a clipboard and tucks back her hair while giving serious instructions.
